```{r, echo = F}
sim_results <- NA 
for (i in c(1:72)) {
  sim_results_new <- as.data.frame(readRDS(paste0('/users/3/turne899/Stratified_Model/unadjusted_sim_081326_new/results_array_081326_',  i, '.rds')))
  sim_results_new$array <- i
  if (i == 1) {
    sim_results <- sim_results_new
  } else {
    sim_results <- rbind(sim_results, sim_results_new)
  }
}
```

```{r, echo = F, warning = F, out.width="75%"}
# calculate the true values of wOR 
#make plot of the various scenarios

#top left corner - stacked bar chart of the various scenarios 
pc <- rep(0.2, 5)
pc1 <- pc
pt1 <- pc 
# low constant risk difference
pt2 <- c(0.26, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.14)
# high constant risk difference 
pt3 <- c(0.27, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.13)
# low RR
pt4 <- c(0.225, 0.225, 0.225, 0.225, 0.10)
# high RR 
pt5 <- c(0.23, 0.23, 0.23, 0.23, 0.08)
# low PO
beta1 <- log(1.37)
pt6 <- c(invlogit(logit(pc1[1]) + beta1),
         invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2]) + beta1) - invlogit(logit(pc1[1]) + beta1),
         invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2] + pc1[3]) + beta1) - invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2]) + beta1),
         invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2] + pc1[3] + pc1[4]) + beta1) - invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2] + pc1[3]) + beta1),
         1 - invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2] + pc1[3] + pc1[4]) + beta1))

# high PO 
beta2 <- log(1.47)
pt7 <- c(invlogit(logit(pc1[1]) + beta2),
         invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2]) + beta2) - invlogit(logit(pc1[1]) + beta2),
         invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2] + pc1[3]) + beta2) - invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2]) + beta2),
         invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2] + pc1[3] + pc1[4]) + beta2) - invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2] + pc1[3]) + beta2),
         1 - invlogit(logit(pc1[1] + pc1[2] + pc1[3] + pc1[4]) + beta2))
# 20% red in last 3, rest to 1 
pt8 <- c(0.29, 0.2, 0.17, 0.17, 0.17)
# 25% red in last 3, rest to 2
pt9 <- c(0.2, 0.35, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15)


scenarios1 <- as.data.frame(rbind(pc, pt1, pt2, pt3, pt4, pt5, pt6, pt7, pt8, pt9))
colnames(scenarios1) <- c("Nothing", "Hypoxemia", "ED Visit", "Hopsitalization", "Death")
scenarios1$Scenario <- c("Control", "Null", "Low RD", "High RD", "Low RR", "High RR", "Low PO", "High PO", 
                         "NP 1", "NP 2")

p1_even <- scenarios1  %>%
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = c("Control", "Null", "Low PO", "High PO", "Low RD", "High RD", 
                                                "Low RR", "High RR", 
                                                 "NP 1", "NP 2"))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Nothing", "Hypoxemia", "ED Visit", "Hopsitalization", "Death"), 
               names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "Proportion") %>% 
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Nothing", "Hypoxemia", "ED Visit", "Hopsitalization", "Death"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Scenario, y = Proportion, fill = Outcome)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 90)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14), legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14), 
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14)) 

rd1 <- cumsum(pt1) - cumsum(pc)
rd2 <- cumsum(pt2) - cumsum(pc)
rd3 <- cumsum(pt3) - cumsum(pc)
rd4 <- cumsum(pt4) - cumsum(pc) 
rd5 <- cumsum(pt5) - cumsum(pc) 
rd6 <- cumsum(pt6) - cumsum(pc) 
rd7 <- cumsum(pt7) - cumsum(pc) 
rd8 <- cumsum(pt8) - cumsum(pc) 
rd9 <- cumsum(pt9) - cumsum(pc) 

risk_dif1 <- as.data.frame(rbind(rd1, rd2, rd3, rd4, rd5, rd6, rd7, rd8, rd9))
colnames(risk_dif1) <- c("Nothing", "Hypoxemia", "ED Visit", "Hopsitalization", "Death")
risk_dif1$Scenario <- c("Null", "Low RD", "High RD", "Low RR", "High RR", "Low PO", "High PO", 
                         "NP 1", "NP 2")

p2 <- risk_dif1 %>% filter(Scenario != "Null") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Nothing", "Hypoxemia", "ED Visit", "Hopsitalization", "Death"), 
               names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "RD") %>% 
  filter(Outcome != "Death") %>%
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Nothing", "Hypoxemia", "ED Visit", "Hopsitalization")),
         Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = c("Low PO", "High PO", "Low RD", "High RD", 
                                                "Low RR", "High RR", 
                                                "NP 1", "NP 2")))  %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Outcome, y = RD, color = Scenario, group = Scenario, linetype = Scenario)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(show.legend = F) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) + ylab("Cumulative RD") + 
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(rep(c("longdash", "solid"), 4))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(rep(brewer.pal(8, "Paired")[2], 2), 
                                rep(brewer.pal(8, "Paired")[4], 2), rep(brewer.pal(8, "Paired")[6], 2),
                                rep(brewer.pal(8, "Paired")[8], 2))) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14), legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14), 
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14))  + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Nothing" = "1|2",
                              "Hypoxemia" = "2|3", 
                              "ED Visit" = "3|4", 
                              "Hopsitalization" = "4|5"))

OR_le <- (PPO_trt_leq / (1- PPO_trt_leq)) / (PPO_ctl_leq / (1- PPO_ctl_leq))
OR_ge <- (PPO_ctl_geq / (1- PPO_ctl_geq)) / (PPO_trt_geq / (1- PPO_trt_geq))

  # fully bayesian with both cumulative and split weights
  numerator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                     (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * 
                     (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])) * log(OR_le[j]))
```

```{r, echo = F, warning = F, message = F, eval = F}
#calculate rmse

covid_scenarios %>% #cbind(blrm_covid_scenarios) %>%
  filter(!is.na(weighted_log_OR_both_100_90_60_10_0)) %>% 
  merge(true_vals, by = "Scenario") %>% 
  mutate(bias_wOR_blrm = weighted_OR_both_PPO - true_wOR_100_75_50_25_0,
         bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0 = weighted_OR_both_100_75_50_25_0 - true_wOR_100_75_50_25_0,
         bias_wOR_100_90_60_10_0 = weighted_OR_both_100_90_60_10_0 - true_wOR_100_90_60_10_0,
         bias_wOR_100_90_80_60_0 = weighted_OR_both_100_90_80_60_0 - true_wOR_100_90_80_60_0,
         bias_mean_utility_100_75_50_25_0 = delta_100_75_50_25_0 - true_mean_utility_100_75_50_25_0,
         bias_mean_utility_100_90_60_10_0 = delta_100_90_60_10_0 - true_mean_utility_100_90_60_10_0,
         bias_mean_utility_100_90_80_60_0 = delta_100_90_80_60_0 - true_mean_utility_100_90_80_60_0,
         bias_NB = NB_100_75_50_25_0 - true_NB) %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(wOR_blrm = sqrt(sum(bias_wOR_blrm^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0))),
            wOR1 = sqrt(sum(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0))),
            wOR2 = sqrt(sum(bias_wOR_100_90_60_10_0^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_wOR_100_90_60_10_0))),
            wOR3 = sqrt(sum(bias_wOR_100_90_80_60_0^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_wOR_100_90_80_60_0))),
            mean_utility1 = sqrt(sum(bias_mean_utility_100_75_50_25_0^2) /
                                                      sum(!is.na(bias_mean_utility_100_75_50_25_0))),
            mean_utility2 = sqrt(sum(bias_mean_utility_100_90_60_10_0^2) /
                                                      sum(!is.na(bias_mean_utility_100_90_60_10_0))),
            mean_utility3 = sqrt(sum(bias_mean_utility_100_90_80_60_0^2) /
                                                      sum(!is.na(bias_mean_utility_100_90_80_60_0))),
            NB = sqrt(sum(bias_NB^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_NB)))) %>%
  select(Scenario, wOR_blrm, wOR1, wOR2, wOR3) %>%
  kable(caption = "RMSE Evenly Distributed Outcome", 
      booktabs = T, align = "c", digits = 3) %>%
  kable_paper("hover")
```

```{r}
# make plot with power of different utilities 
util_table_plot <- covid_scenarios %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>% 
  merge(true_ORs, by = "Scenario") %>% 
  merge(true_vals, by = "Scenario") %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
            wOR_util1_Power_both = sum((`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0 & 
                          `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0) |
                            (`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0`)),
            wOR_util2_Power_both = sum((`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0` > 0 & 
                          `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_90_80_60_0` > 0) |
                            (`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0` < 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_90_80_60_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0`)),
            wOR_util3_Power_both = sum((`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0` > 0 & 
                          `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_90_60_10_0` > 0) |
                            (`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0` < 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_90_60_10_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0`)),
            
            wOR_util1_Power_util = sum((`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_util_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0) |
                            (`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_util_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0`)),
            wOR_util2_Power_util = sum((`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0` > 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_util_CI.97.5%_100_90_80_60_0` > 0) |
                            (`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0` < 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_util_CI.97.5%_100_90_80_60_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0`)),
            wOR_util3_Power_util = sum((`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0` > 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_util_CI.97.5%_100_90_60_10_0` > 0) |
                            (`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0` < 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_util_CI.97.5%_100_90_60_10_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`weighted_log_OR_util_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0`)),
            
            delta_util1_Power_util = sum((`delta_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0 &
                          `delta_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0) |
                            (`delta_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0 &
                          `delta_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`delta_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0`)),
            delta_util2_Power_util = sum((`delta_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0` > 0 &
                          `delta_CI.97.5%_100_90_80_60_0` > 0) |
                            (`delta_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0` < 0 &
                          `delta_CI.97.5%_100_90_80_60_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`delta_CI.2.5%_100_90_80_60_0`)),
            delta_util3_Power_util = sum((`delta_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0` > 0 &
                          `delta_CI.97.5%_100_90_60_10_0` > 0) |
                            (`delta_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0` < 0 &
                          `delta_CI.97.5%_100_90_60_10_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`delta_CI.2.5%_100_90_60_10_0`))
            ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Scenario,
               names_to = "Measure",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  separate(Measure, c("Summary", "Utilities", "Measure", "Weights")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Measure", values_from = "Value") %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  mutate(Utilities = case_match(Utilities, "util1" ~ "0, 25, 50, 75, 100",
                            "util2" ~ "0, 60, 80, 90, 100",
                            "util3" ~ "0, 10, 60, 90, 100")) 


power_util <- util_table_plot %>% filter(Summary %in% c("wOR", "delta")) %>% 
  mutate(Utilities = factor(Utilities, levels = c("0, 25, 50, 75, 100", "0, 10, 60, 90, 100", "0, 60, 80, 90, 100")),

                              levels = c("wOR both", "wOR util", "delta util"))) %>%
  filter(Scenario %in% c("Null", "Low PO", "NP 1", "NP 3", "NP 5", "NP 6")) %>%

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(brewer.pal(10, "Paired")[6],  brewer.pal(10, "Paired")[8],
```
